newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle firm-up $1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle firm-up $1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were firm to mostly $0.50 higher versus Tuesday's close. Trade active. Demand moderate to good, USDA said.
Seller interest moderate to good. Offerings current.
Steers Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1350 lbs 64.50-65.50 few Choice to 66.00.
Heifers Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 65.00-65.50 few Choice 66.00.
